content:
The BUILT CoLAB took part in Encontro Ciência 2021, Portugal's annual science, technology and innovation meeting, held from 28 to 30 June. This year's motto was "The Science that Makes Tomorrow and Transforms the Economy", and the main challenges and opportunities in Portuguese and European science at the current moment were discussed, covering topics such as the future of employment, space exploration, the digital transition and climate change.


The event's programme of thematic sessions included a session dedicated to the CoLABs, in which BUILT CoLAB took part. João Moutinho, Business & Internationalization Director, addressed the topic of Artificial Intelligence as a Mega Trend of Innovation. The video of the session is available online and can be found here.

The remaining panels also featured the participation of other collaborative laboratories, such as DTx – Digital Transformation CoLAB, Value for Health CoLAB, Colabatlantic, MORE – Laboratório Colaborativo Montanhas de Investigação, BIOREF – Collaborative Laboratory (CoLAB), VORTEX-CoLab, CoLAB NET4CO2, ALMASCIENCE – Beyond Paper.


The event was held in hybrid format, with live online streaming on YouTube and an in-person session at the Lisbon Congress Centre, and was promoted by the Fundação para a Ciência e Tecnologia in collaboration with Ciência Viva and the Parliamentary Committee on Education, Science, Youth and Sport, with the institutional support of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Higher Education.


Full information about the event here.
